summary: Google DeepMind released Optax v0.2.5, a JAX optimization library update adding new optimizers (Sophia-H, Muon, AdEMAMix, ADOPT), deprecating multi_transform in favor of partition, removing longtime deprecated functions, and including numerous bug fixes and documentation improvements.

practices.reason: Teams using multi_transform or the removed deprecated functions must migrate their code before upgrading.
